title: F1 alt-mechanism: crib boundary positions as numeric width/depth roles
hypothesis_summary: Alternative-mechanism counterpart to the F1 proponents. Same evidence (disclosed crib spans) but a structurally different reading: the crib boundary indices (21, 24, 25, 33, 64, 69, 70, 73) carry the cipher hint, not the crib WORDS. We project the boundary indices into hand-cipher numeric roles — widths in the 7-13 / 21-33 ranges, rail-fence depths from the small-divisor projections — and test whether the existing core public-crib keywords compose with those numeric roles. The 21 / 33 / 73 indices are inherited as widths; depths are taken from boundary-difference values 4 / 5 / 9 / 11 (intervals between adjacent crib endpoints).

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Core public cribs registered as keyword pool (TIER_CORE_PUBLIC_CRIBS).

composition_templates.rationale: Three-role: sub-keyword + columnar + rail-fence depth from crib endpoint differences.
Two-layer Vig + rail_fence with crib-derived depths.

constraints: Numeric roles drawn ONLY from crib endpoints and endpoint-differences within the disclosed spans.
caveats: ALTERNATIVE-MECHANISM framing — uses the SAME evidence as the F1 proponents but treats numeric span structure as the cipher hint instead of crib content.
Confidence kept low: numerology from positions is easily overfit. The pack exists to be CHECKED against the proponents, not to support its own conclusions.
